ai.panel.includeValuesHint: Off by default. Names that look secret and token-like values are redacted.
ai.panel.footer: Sends the conversation above plus your question to your AI endpoint. The thread stays with this tab until you close it.
errorRow.label: Error on line {{line}}
ai.panel.applyOnlyIntro: This replaces the current code with the AI suggestion without running it. Review the change:
ai.panel.mode.localUnset: Pick a local model in Settings → Account → AI. Ollama or LM Studio must be running.
ai.panel.mode.remoteUnset: Add your endpoint, API key, and model in Settings → Account → AI.
ai.panel.mode.localOtherHost: Local reaches only localhost or 127.0.0.1, on this machine. Change the Local endpoint in Settings → Account → AI.
ai.edit.title: Edit selection with AI
ai.edit.instruction: Ask AI to change the selection
ai.edit.skippedLanguage: Only JavaScript, TypeScript and Python changes run before you accept them; check the diff.
ai.edit.notice: Before you accept it, the change runs once outside your Console and history, with network requests blocked and a 5 s limit.
ai.edit.redactedAnswer: The answer still holds a masked secret, so it cannot be accepted as is.
ai.edit.stale: The file changed since you asked; close this and open Edit with AI again.
